assessment: Evidence-backed verification inventory; not a claim that blocked OS/hardware cases were executed.

environment.localHostInventory: Windows 11 Pro x64 26H2 build 26300; native host inventoried but excluded from candidate acceptance, reboot, lock, sleep, audio playback, and system theme changes because it is the user's personal machine and no isolated VM or sandbox was available.
environment.blocker: No disposable VM/Sandbox/hypervisor/self-hosted runner was available; current hosted run is Windows Server 2025, and GitHub-hosted labels do not provide consumer Windows 11 x64.

suiteAssertionTotals.note: Current candidate-run assertions: 20,100 core across three 6,700 runs; 197 package checks; 521 GUI assertions; 1,180 installed acceptance checks; 263 exact-production-EXE soak checks; and 2 exact-candidate launch smokes. Supplemental ARM64 emulation assertions are recorded separately and not double-counted here.

releaseAssessment.confirmedProductDefect: None in the recorded exact-candidate evidence. Two supplemental ARM harness failures were diagnosed as harness API binding and cleanup timing issues, then the same candidate passed the corrected retest.
releaseAssessment.exhaustiveVerification: Incomplete: NOT TESTED and BLOCKED cases remain, including native Windows 11 x64, genuine reboot, Narrator speech, acoustic output, actual lock/sleep, multi-monitor topology, and exhaustive control-state/theme/DPI sweeps.
releaseAssessment.recommendation: Do not claim exhaustive verification or publish as exhaustively tested. Many previously mislabeled UI rows were reconciled to direct passing events in run 43698996008; material OS, audio, display and accessibility coverage remains.

cases.description: Real displayed tick during live HTTP response
cases.expected: A displayed countdown tick occurs while a real production request remains in-flight.
cases.actual: One candidate acceptance event logged 60→59 while the update button remained disabled. A separate explicit live-request probe observed the displayed tick after 1.11 seconds and recorded that the response had already completed. The disabled button proves the UI completion callback had not re-enabled it, not that the HTTPS socket was still in flight; exact real overlap is therefore unproven.

environment.reason: Hosted Windows Server 2025 x64 candidate acceptance ran the exact installed candidate. It did not use a controlled slow real HTTPS endpoint or direct in-flight socket instrumentation.

cases.limitation: Use an authorized controlled slow HTTPS route or network instrumentation that proves the real candidate request remains in flight at the exact displayed tick; do not infer socket state from the disabled button alone.
